assessment: The proposed blocks are the right home: Proposition 1 states the same unique invariant Gibbs measure claim, and Lemma 1.2 is the specific PF justification of that claim. The same gap remains because Lemma 1.2 derives the Gibbs measure from the formal gradient/reversible structure but gives no ergodicity, strong Feller/irreducibility, or Dirichlet-form argument proving uniqueness.
